mapper.select: SELECT ui.user_info_id AS userId, ui.username AS nickname, NULL AS avatarUrl, pair.conversation_id AS conversationId, COALESCE( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = pair.conversation_id AND m.sender_id <> #{userId} AND (self.last_read_msg_id IS NULL OR m.message_id > self.last_read_msg_id) ), 0 ) AS unreadCount FROM user_info ui LEFT JOIN im_dm_pair pair ON ( pair.user_a = #{userId} AND pair.user_b = ui.user_info_id OR pair.user_b = #{userId} AND pair.user_a = ui.user_info_id ) LEFT JOIN im_conversation_member self ON self.conversation_id = pair.conversation_id AND self.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ui.user_info_id IN ( SELECT f.friend_user_id FROM friendship f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT f.user_id FROM friendship f WHERE f.friend_user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY ui.username ASC
